about_page.story_heading: From A Small Pune Studio To A Multi-Service IT Partner
about_page.story_text: Websoftera started with one belief: that small and mid-sized businesses deserve the same quality of digital work that large enterprises pay agencies a fortune for. We launched in 2020 with a focus on website development and quickly expanded as clients asked for more — apps, ERP systems, marketing campaigns, and staff training.
about_page.story_quote: We don't just build websites. We help businesses think clearly about what they want to achieve online — and then we build that.
about_page.story_text2: Today, Websoftera serves clients across India and internationally — from service businesses and educational institutions to import-export firms and sports academies. Our Pune team handles every engagement from strategy to support, with no outsourcing and no junior-only execution.
about_page.mission_tagline: To help growing organizations use technology with confidence.
about_page.vision_tagline: To become the preferred digital transformation partner for businesses that value craft, reliability, and results.
about_page.culture_heading: A Team That Takes Quality Personally
about_page.culture_text: Websoftera is built on a flat, professional culture where everyone's work matters. Our team spans web development, app engineering, design, marketing, and training — all under the same roof in Pune.
about_page.culture_text2: We work with clients who take their digital presence seriously. That means we attract team members who care about output, not just hours. Reviews don't go out without proper QA. Projects don't go live without client sign-off.

contact_page.intro: Share what you're working on — a website, an app, an ERP system, a marketing push. Our team will come back with a practical recommendation, not a sales pitch.
contact_page.form_subtitle: We respond within one business day — usually same day.
contact_page.response_note: Mon–Sat business hours. WhatsApp even faster.
contact_page.whatsapp_message: Hi, I have a project inquiry for Websoftera.

career_page.intro: Websoftera is growing — and we're looking for developers, marketers, and designers who want to work on real client projects, with an experienced team, in a professional environment.
career_page.culture_heading: A Place Where Your Work Actually Matters
career_page.culture_text: At Websoftera, you don't spend your first six months on coffee runs or internal decks. From week one, you're working on real client projects — with guidance, proper tools, and a team that reviews your output seriously.
career_page.culture_text2: We're a small but experienced team. That means you get exposure to every part of a project — planning, design, build, testing, and client communication — not just one narrow function.
